names.note: The heading of days.pravoslavie.ru's name page 14536, «Александра (Булгакова), мц.», with the rank word left off.

death.note: The year the calendar's day line prints after her name: «Мц. Александры (1938)».

feast.note: Her name page lists one other day, «26 января (Новомуч.)», the synaxis of the new martyrs and confessors of Russia. One row per church is the schema, so the second day is recorded here and she does not render on it.

source.note: The rank is the alt text of the icon the page sets before the group of lines hers stands in, «Cовершается служба, не отмеченная в Типиконе никаким знаком» — a service the Typikon marks with no sign at all.

attestations.note: Not checked: doxologia.ro's own 15 octombrie was not read (2026-10-04); the Romanian calendar does not generally keep the Russian new martyrs.
Not checked: saint.gr/10/15 was not read for her (2026-10-04).
Not checked: pravoslavno.rs's Prologue page for civil 15 October 2026 was not read (2026-10-04).
